fields.method: auto | auto+review | person. See PLAN.md section 7.1.
fields.test_groups: page | template | site | process. Where the automatic test or the finder runs. See PLAN.md section 5.3.
fields.conditions: For the three auto criteria: the conditions under which a script decides.
fields.non_interference: One of the four criteria of WCAG 2.2 conformance requirement 5.2.5.
fields.finder_reliable: True when the engine can give the result 'No content found' for this criterion. False when the finder is a heuristic.
fields.context_dependent: True when the answer to a review question depends on the context of the item, so the question fingerprint includes the context.
fields.person_task: A task that a person does at each audit, with or without candidates from the engine. Null when candidates drive the person check.
fields.affects: First assessment of the groups of PLAN.md section 3.1 that the criterion protects most: visual, auditory, physical, speech, cognitive, seizure.

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.automatic_test: Finds images, icons, and image buttons with no text alternative.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI compares each text alternative with its image, in its context. A person confirms the sample.
criteria.notes: The correct alternative depends on the context. The same image can need different alternatives on different pages.

criteria.notes: A missing track element is not a failure signal. The criterion applies only to synchronized media.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <video> elements have captions

act_rules.name: Video element auditory content has accessible alternative

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds each video. A description track is a hint only, because the audio itself can give the visual information.
criteria.review_or_person_check: Make sure that an audio description or a text alternative is there.
criteria.person_task: Play each video. Make sure that an audio description or a full text alternative is there.

act_rules.name: Video element visual content has accessible alternative

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds live video players.
criteria.review_or_person_check: Make sure that live captions are there.
criteria.person_task: Find each live video. Make sure that live captions are there.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds each video. A description track is a hint only.
criteria.review_or_person_check: Make sure that an audio description is there.
criteria.person_task: Play each video. Make sure that an audio description is there.

act_rules.name: Video element visual content has strict accessible alternative
Video element visual content has accessible alternative

criteria.review_or_person_check: AI finds text that looks like a heading, a list, or a table but has no such code.
criteria.notes: The axe-core rules for landmarks, regions, and heading order have no WCAG tag.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.automatic_test: Compares the order in the code with the order on the screen.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI reads the content in code order and examines the sense.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.automatic_test: Finds instructions with words for shape, color, size, position, or sound.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI and a person examine each instruction.
criteria.notes: The finder is a word list. It can miss instructions.

act_rules.name: Content has alternative for visual reference

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.automatic_test: Loads each page in portrait and in landscape. Finds CSS that rotates or hides content on the orientation media feature.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person decides if a lock is essential.
criteria.notes: The approved ACT rule covers only CSS on the orientation media feature. The axe-core rule is experimental and off.

axe_rules.description: Ensure content is not locked to any specific display orientation, and the content is operable in all display orientations

act_rules.name: Orientation of the page is not restricted using CSS transforms

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.automatic_test: Tests the autocomplete value of each field that has one. Flags fields for personal data with no value.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI decides if a flagged field collects data about the user. A person confirms the sample.
criteria.notes: The ACT rule and axe-core only validate an attribute that is there. A field with no attribute needs judgment.

axe_rules.description: Ensure the autocomplete attribute is correct and suitable for the form field

act_rules.name: `autocomplete` attribute has valid value

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.automatic_test: Finds links in text that only color shows.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines screenshots for states, errors, and charts that only color shows.

axe_rules.description: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.automatic_test: Finds audio that starts automatically and plays for more than 3 seconds. Looks for a control that can pause, stop, or change the volume.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms the control, and examines embedded players.
criteria.notes: Non-interference criterion. The test runs on each page and each state, with the cookie banner open. The ACT rule is proposed. The axe-core rule only flags for review.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <video> or <audio> elements do not autoplay audio for more than 3 seconds without a control mechanism to stop or mute the audio

act_rules.name: Audio or video element avoids automatically playing audio

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.automatic_test: Calculates the contrast of all text from the code and the styles, including placeholder text and text on hover and focus. The limits are 4.5:1, and 3:1 for large text, which is 18 point or 14 point bold. Flags text on an image or a gradient.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI and a person decide the exceptions: inactive controls, decoration, invisible text, text in a picture with other significant content, and logotypes.
criteria.notes: W3C says to take the colors from the code and the styles, not from the screen.

axe_rules.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

act_rules.name: Text has minimum contrast
Text has enhanced contrast

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.automatic_test: Emulates 200% zoom. Finds a block of zoom, which is an automatic failure. Flags text that is cut or hidden.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms that the cut content is not available on focus or after activation. Captions and images of text are exceptions.
criteria.notes: Playwright has no zoom function. The engine uses half the viewport width and a device scale factor of 2. The zoom block has an approved ACT rule.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming

act_rules.name: Zoomed text node is not clipped with CSS overflow
Meta viewport allows for zoom

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.automatic_test: AI with vision finds images that contain text. Finds an image of text next to the same text, which passes.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person decides the definition and the exceptions: a picture with other significant content, 'customizable', and 'essential', for example a logo.

act_rules.name: HTML images contain no text

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.automatic_test: Sets the width to 320 CSS px for vertical content, and the height to 256 CSS px for horizontal content. Finds a scroll in two directions and cut content.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person decides the exceptions for each part with two dimensions: maps, diagrams, video, data tables, and toolbars.
criteria.notes: Content that moves to a new position is not a loss.

act_rules.name: Meta viewport allows for zoom

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.automatic_test: Calculates the contrast of control borders and focus rings.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI and a person examine icons and charts.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.automatic_test: Applies the WCAG spacing values. Flags text that is cut or that overlaps.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms that the content is not available, for example after an ellipsis. Images of text and canvas are out of the scope.
criteria.notes: The approved ACT rules cover only inline styles with !important. The axe-core rule avoid-inline-spacing is not consistent with them (W3C report, research question 2), so the own test stays necessary.

axe_rules.description: Ensure that text spacing set through style attributes can be adjusted with custom stylesheets

act_rules.name: Important letter spacing in style attributes is wide enough
Important line height in style attributes is wide enough
Important word spacing in style attributes is wide enough

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.automatic_test: Moves the pointer and the focus to each control. Tests the new content with Esc and with the pointer.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms the results.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.automatic_test: Finds controls that the keyboard cannot get to or operate.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person tests complex controls, for example a map or an editor.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <frame> and <iframe> elements with focusable content do not have tabindex=-1
Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard in Safari
Ensure that server-side image maps are not used

act_rules.name: Scrollable content can be reached with sequential focus navigation
Iframe with interactive elements is not excluded from tab-order

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.automatic_test: Moves through all controls with Tab and Shift+Tab. Flags a trap.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms that the page does not tell the user how to leave. A dialog that the user knows how to leave passes.
criteria.notes: Non-interference criterion. The Tab pass runs on each page and each state, with the cookie banner open.

act_rules.name: Focusable element has no keyboard trap

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.automatic_test: Presses each character key in the protected mode. Finds shortcuts, and the listeners for single keys.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that you can stop or change a shortcut.
criteria.notes: Key presses on a live site run only in the protected mode of PLAN.md section 4.5.

act_rules.name: No keyboard shortcut uses only printable characters

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.automatic_test: Fails a meta refresh with a delay between 1 and 72,000 seconds. Finds timers that redirect.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person tests the time limits of sessions.
criteria.person_task: Test the time limits of sessions and of each process.
criteria.notes: The approved ACT rule bc659a fails a meta refresh. The session limits stay with a person.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh

act_rules.name: Meta element has no refresh delay
Meta element has no refresh delay (no exception)

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.automatic_test: Flags content that moves, blinks, or scrolls for more than 5 seconds. Flags all content that updates automatically, with no time limit.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that a control can pause, stop, or hide it, or that it is essential.
criteria.notes: Non-interference criterion. The five seconds apply only to information that moves, blinks, or scrolls. There is no five-second exception for content that updates automatically.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <blink> elements are not used
Ensure <marquee> elements are not used

act_rules.name: Text content that changes automatically can be paused, stopped or hidden

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.automatic_test: Finds animation and video.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person or a special tool measures the flash rate.
criteria.person_task: Look for content that flashes. Measure the flash rate of each candidate with a tool.
criteria.notes: Non-interference criterion. The finder gives candidates only.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.automatic_test: Finds the skip link and the landmarks.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms which blocks repeat on many pages, and that a way to bypass them is there.
criteria.notes: The axe-core rule only flags for review. The ACT rule is a proposed composite.

axe_rules.description: Ensure each page has at least one mechanism for a user to bypass navigation and jump straight to the content

act_rules.name: Bypass Blocks of Repeated Content

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.automatic_test: Finds pages with no title and pages with the same title.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines if the title describes the page.

axe_rules.description: Ensure each HTML document contains a non-empty <title> element

act_rules.name: HTML page has non-empty title
HTML page title is descriptive

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.automatic_test: Compares the focus order with the visual order. Tests the focus in dialogs.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms that the order keeps the meaning.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds links with no name, and links with general text such as 'read more'.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines each link text in its context.

axe_rules.description: Ensure <area> elements of image maps have alternative text
Ensure links have discernible text

act_rules.name: Link in context is descriptive
Link has non-empty accessible name
Links with identical accessible names and same context serve equivalent purpose

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.automatic_test: Looks for navigation, search, and a sitemap. Finds pages that no link points to.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms.
criteria.notes: Pages that are a step in a process are an exception.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.automatic_test: Collects each heading and label with its content. Reports empty headings and labels under 1.3.1, 3.3.2, or 4.1.2, because 2.4.6 does not require headings.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines if each heading and label describes its content.

act_rules.name: Heading is descriptive
Form field label is descriptive

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.automatic_test: Sends real Tab events, scrolls each control into view, and compares a screenshot of the full viewport with focus and with no focus. Ignores animation.
criteria.review_or_person_check: None. The research confirms the test on the ACT cases.
criteria.conditions: A script decides only with real Tab events, the control scrolled into view, a comparison of the full viewport, and animation ignored. A new issue needs the same result in two renders.
criteria.notes: The approved ACT rule oj04fd has only partial automatic implementations.

act_rules.name: Element in sequential focus order has visible focus

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.automatic_test: Tests if a fixed header, banner, or widget hides the control that has focus completely, in the initial positions.
criteria.review_or_person_check: None. Content that the user opened and can close does not count.
criteria.conditions: A script decides only 'entirely hidden', in the initial positions of the fixed elements. Content that the user opened and can close without a move of the focus does not count.
criteria.notes: No ACT rule and no axe-core rule exist.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.automatic_test: Finds sliders, carousels, and maps that use gestures.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that one pointer can do the function.
criteria.person_task: Find each function that uses a gesture with more than one point or a path. Make sure that one pointer can do it.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.automatic_test: Finds controls that act when the pointer goes down.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms one of four options: no down-event, abort or undo, up reversal, or essential.
criteria.notes: Frameworks delegate events at the root, so a listener test cannot see each control.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.automatic_test: Compares the visible label with the accessible name of widgets with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines labels in images of text. A symbol is not a label.
criteria.notes: The ACT rule is proposed. The axe-core rule label-content-name-mismatch is on by default in 4.14.0, and it covers only widgets with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

axe_rules.description: Ensure that elements labelled through their content must have their visible text as part of their accessible name

act_rules.name: Visible label is part of accessible name
Form field has non-empty accessible name

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.automatic_test: Finds listeners for device motion in the browser, and in the source code.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person tests the alternative control.
criteria.person_task: Find each function that the motion of the device starts. Make sure that a control can do it, and that the user can switch the motion off.
criteria.notes: Research question 7 compares the listener test with the search in the source code.

act_rules.name: Device motion based changes to the content can also be created from the user interface
Device motion based changes to the content can be disabled

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.automatic_test: Finds elements that you can drag, from the drag and pointer listeners.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that a function with no drag is there.
criteria.person_task: Find each function that needs a drag. Make sure that a single pointer can do it with no drag.
criteria.notes: No ACT rule and no axe-core rule exist.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.automatic_test: Measures the size of each target and the space around it. A slider is one target. Overlapped areas do not count.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person decides the exceptions 'equivalent' and 'essential'.
criteria.notes: No ACT rule exists. The axe-core rule target-size is off by default, and the engine switches it on (research question 2). The minimum is 24 by 24 CSS px, or an equal spacing.

axe_rules.description: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.automatic_test: Tests that the language attribute is there and is valid. Compares it with the language that the page uses most.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms a mismatch on a short or mixed page.
criteria.notes: The presence and the validity of the attribute have approved ACT rules. The match with the text has a proposed rule.

axe_rules.description: Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute
Ensure the lang attribute of the <html> element has a valid value
Ensure that HTML elements with both valid lang and xml:lang attributes agree on the base language of the page

act_rules.name: HTML page has lang attribute
HTML page `lang` attribute has valid language tag
HTML page language subtag matches default language

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.automatic_test: Finds text in a different language with no language attribute.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI and a person confirm short text.
criteria.notes: Proper names and technical terms are exceptions.

axe_rules.description: Ensure lang attributes have valid values

act_rules.name: Element with lang attribute has valid language tag
HTML element language subtag matches language

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.automatic_test: Moves the focus to each control in the protected mode. Fails a change of page, window, or focus. Flags content that changes the meaning.
criteria.review_or_person_check: None for the automatic failure. A review decides the flagged content changes.
criteria.conditions: A script decides only a change of page, window, or focus. Content that changes the meaning goes to the review. A menu that opens or a tab control is not a change of context by itself.
criteria.notes: A change of context includes a move of the focus and content that changes the meaning.

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.automatic_test: Changes the value of each select, checkbox, and radio button. Types in fields where permitted. Finds a change of page or window.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that the page gave a warning.
criteria.notes: Text entry runs only where PLAN.md section 4.5 permits.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.automatic_test: Compares the relative order of the navigation on all pages of a set. Permits insertions and removals.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms the differences.
criteria.notes: The scope is a set of web pages.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.automatic_test: Finds controls with the same function but different names.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI and a person confirm.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.automatic_test: Finds contact links and help links. Compares their order in the code on all pages of a set, at each width.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person confirms.
criteria.notes: The order is the serialized order, in the same page variation. No ACT rule and no axe-core rule exist.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.automatic_test: Sends incorrect data in forms where permitted. Tests how each error shows.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines the error text.
criteria.notes: A form submission runs only on staging or with permission.

act_rules.name: Error message describes invalid form field value

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.automatic_test: Finds fields with no visible label.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines if the instructions are sufficient.

axe_rules.description: Ensure form field does not have multiple label elements

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.automatic_test: Collects the error messages from the form tests.
criteria.review_or_person_check: AI examines if each message tells how to correct the error.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds forms for payment, orders, and legal data, forms that change or delete data of the user, and forms with test answers.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person tests if you can check, correct, or cancel the data.
criteria.person_task: Do each process with legal, financial, or user data. Make sure that the user can reverse, check, or confirm the data.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.automatic_test: Finds processes with more than one step.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person does the process and looks for data that you must type again.
criteria.person_task: Do each process with more than one step. Look for data that the user must type again in the same process.
criteria.notes: No ACT rule and no axe-core rule exist.

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.automatic_test: Finds login forms. Tests paste and autocomplete in their fields, because a block fails unless an alternative exists. Finds a CAPTCHA.
criteria.review_or_person_check: A person makes sure that a method with no cognitive function test is there, or one of the exceptions: alternative, mechanism, object recognition, or personal content.
